variant.author: Glyceri
variant.changelog:
# Version 1.5.0

Roll timers, passes and a way to report problems.

- New: every item in the roll window shows how long is left to roll on it, with a bar that turns amber and then red.
- New: passes now appear in the results, along with items you aren't allowed to roll on and party members who never chose.
- New: while an item is open, the roll window lists who in your party still has to decide.
- New: when an item is awarded, its card plays a short light sweep and spark burst. Follows your particle effect settings.
- Every loot session now reaches an end: items everyone passed on, items that timed out and rolls you left the duty on all close properly.
- Each resolved item leaves the roll window on its own after 20 seconds, with a countdown on the card. Adjustable in Settings - Tracking.
- New: Settings - Diagnostics shows LootView's live log, filterable by level and text, and copies a ready-to-paste report.
- New: Report a bug and Suggest a feature buttons open a pre-filled GitHub issue.
variant.description:
Automatically copy ANY text on your screen.

There are two modes:
        -Normal Mode: Automatically copies a select number of text elements to your clipboard.
        -Text Copy Mode: This mode allows you to copy the text of ANY text element on the screen.

Default keybinds to toggle between the two modes are:
      [Left Control] [Left Shift] [Spacebar]

variant.punchline: Automatically copy ANY text on your screen by choice.
